reason: Item 1 of EO 11241 amended subparagraph (3) of paragraph (a) of section 1631.7 of Part 1631, Quotas and Calls, of the Selective Service Regulations, and item 3 states that the effective date of the amended subparagraphs is the date of the order, August 26, 1965. A rewrite of regulation text is performed once, so the order's own command was spent on that date; the first end is therefore August 26, 1965 by performance on issue (the order states no later effective date). The text it put in the regulation survived as a separate consequence until EO 11497 of November 26, 1969, section 3, revoked paragraphs (a) and (b) of section 1631.7 and prescribed a new paragraph (a); that revocation is recorded as a later event, not as the first end. EO 11360 (June 30, 1967) amended paragraph (a) only by adding an opening phrase and striking words from its second proviso, which did not change subparagraph (3), and is recorded as a later amendment. EO 12553 (February 25, 1986) revoked EO 11241 by number in a cleanup list and is the formal disposition after the earlier end.
